'''Flame beetles''' were [[Beetle/Legends|beetles]] that lived in the "multilayered deathtrap" ecosystem of the [[Forest/Legends|forests]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. Ranging from 4 to 12 [[Centimeter/Legends|centimeters]] long, these pests could deliver an extremely painful bite due to their mild [[Poison/Legends|venom]]. The flame beetles were named for their ability to spontaneously combust into [[Fire/Legends|flames]] through chemicals in their bodies. While a lone beetle wasn't considered too dangerous, this event normally occurred throughout a whole swarm of over 100 individuals, each beetle exploding with the effect of a [[Fragmentation grenade/Legends|fragmentation grenade]]. Flame beetles hatchlings gave off unique pheromones.<ref name="Gamer 4" />

While [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] naturalists couldn't determine the reasons for their combustion, it was suspected that it was an extreme self-defense reaction. Normally the flame beetles only swarmed in the lower levels of [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|wroshyr tree]] [[Forest/Legends|forests]], and the few times when Wookiees did encounter them they could usually be driven off with simple smoke pots. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] a swarm of beetles set fire to [[Turren Lonarr]]'s office. This was actually a distraction to cover his insertion of [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] hunters into Kashyyyk.<ref name="Gamer 4" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] found a specimen of this species in a storage room of the [[Mensix Mining Facility/Legends|Mensix Mining Facility]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]].<ref name="Galaxies">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Flame_beetle.jpg|thumb|right|An illustration of a flame beetle]]
Flame beetles appeared in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online role-playing game developed by [[Sony]] and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
